name: Folio — PDF tools
description: Open and inspect PDFs in Chrome. Documents are processed on your device and never uploaded.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
